question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
gold: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
gold0: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

d.request: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users who created more than 10 posts, also keeping users that have no matching record in the joined table?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_upvotes, AVG(u.Age) AS avg_age FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId) p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE p.post_count > 10

b.request: Using a LEFT JOIN from users to posts (so users with no matching posts are kept), compute for users with more than 10 posts (COUNT of their posts by UserId > 10) the average UpVotes (SUM(UpVotes)/COUNT(UserId)) and the average Age (SUM(Age)/COUNT(UserId))
b.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(u.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes, CAST(SUM(u.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10) p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL

c.request:
What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
Evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))
Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
c.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(t.Id) AS avg_upvotes, CAST(SUM(t.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(t.Id) AS avg_age FROM (SELECT u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId GROUP BY u.Id, u.UpVotes, u.Age HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10) AS t
